partnershipPlan: Two members of the patient and family advisory council review the questionnaire introduction and the plain-language results; a rural patient support organisation advises on travel questions.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments to the centre's patient experience service about parking and travel in the last year are summarised.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I moved my infusion twice because I could not afford the fuel that week.
items.implication: Ask about delays and travel costs directly.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I took unpaid leave to drive him to every appointment; nobody asked how we were managing.
items.implication: Include carers' lost income in the spending questions.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I did not tick the money box because it felt like begging.
items.implication: Test the checkbox against the questionnaire and word the introduction with care.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We usually hear about money problems when someone has already missed a cycle.
items.implication: Restrict to the first six months when spending peaks.

summary: Four composite voices on delays, carers' income, privacy about money and late discovery.
